tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/password-hashing.md <<'EOF'
# Password hashing

No decision on the password hashing algorithm is currently recorded for this project. Until one is recorded, no algorithm, cost parameter or library is prescribed by this policy.
EOF
cat docs/policies/password-hashing.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/password-hashing.md`. It says that no decision on the password hashing algorithm is currently recorded, and that the policy prescribes no algorithm, cost parameter or library.

Muninn has no decision or standing rule on password hashing. Its catalog lists only the TLS, https, verification and cache decisions, and `muninn why` came back "insufficient". The only related items are two unconfirmed, single-session notes: one says bcrypt, and a later one says argon2id. Neither was confirmed, and they conflict. I left both out rather than pick one.

If you want a value on record, tell me the algorithm and I'll update the file.
